notes: New skins: Spy row 7 Goku (rebuilt, clean chest and arms) and Female Spy row 9 Lara, plus the tactical skins (Breacher, Viper, Ghost, Sandstorm, Metro Police, Special Forces, SWAT, FBI HRT), spy row 8 Cape and the in-lobby skin switch. Spawn protection fix (GamBox): another player finishing a file no longer ends your spawn protection. Smoke mine: a mine nobody trips expires after 45 s without smoke. Everyone in a match needs this build to see the same skins.
